theme.label: Theme
theme.heading: Appearance
theme.hint: Device follows the light or dark setting of your phone or computer. Your choice is kept in this browser and on your account, so signing in elsewhere brings it with you.
appearance.textSize.label: Text size
appearance.contrast.label: Contrast
appearance.motion.label: Motion
appearance.hint: Larger text makes every size on the page bigger. More contrast darkens secondary text and edges so all text reaches the highest readability standard. Reduced motion stops animations. Device follows the setting of your phone or computer.
appearance.guest: Sign in to change your profile, privacy, following and viewing territory. Your appearance choices are kept in this browser, and on your account once you sign in.
account.delete.heading: Delete my account
account.delete.removed: Deleting your account signs you out on every device and removes your e-mail address, password, display name, biography, preferences, follows, friendships, blocks, group memberships and invitations, and your push subscriptions.
account.delete.kept: Your messages and match panel posts stay where they were written, shown as by a deleted member. Your published community analysis is taken down. Your predictions and their settlements stay as records without your name, because other members' ratings were computed against them. Reports you made are kept for the moderation record.
account.delete.username: Your username is retired: nobody can register it after you. A group you own passes to its longest-standing moderator, or member; a group with nobody else in it is closed.
account.delete.confirmHint: Type {username} exactly as it is written here.
account.deleted.title: Your account was deleted
account.deleted.body: Your account was deleted and every session was signed out. Your predictions remain as records without your name.
account.export.heading: Download my data
account.export.contents: One file (JSON) of what this site holds about you: your account and preferences, follows, friendships, groups, every version of your predictions and how they settled, your rating history and achievements, saved stories, the messages and match panel posts you wrote, your community analysis, the reports you filed and the notifications sent to you.
account.export.others: Only your own words and rows are in it: never another member's messages, name or predictions. A conversation shows only what you wrote.
account.export.once: One file a day. It downloads here, in this browser, and is never sent by e-mail.
account.export.refused.password: That password is not right. No file was made.
account.export.refused.daily: You downloaded a copy less than a day ago. The next one is possible a day after that.
account.export.refused.limited: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a while and try again.
account.export.refused.signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again to download your data.
account.export.refused.unavailable: The service is unreachable right now. No file was made.
languageHold.notice: this language is held back for now, so FMIP is shown in English. Your choice is kept, and applies again when the language returns.
